sections.title: Mastering Hungarian Information Structure
sections.content: You know the focus position before the verb from A1 Unit 4. Here you use it for contrast: the word right before the verb carries the new or contrasting information, and *nem ..., hanem* names the alternative.

items.spanish: Nem én mondtam, hogy gyere ide, hanem Péter.
items.english: It wasn't me who said to come here, it was Péter.

items.spanish: A könyvet olvastam, nem az újságot.
items.english: It was the book I read, not the newspaper.
This is precisely what I wanted to ask you!
